visa_types.official_name: Issuing a multi-entry tourist visa (5 years)

conditions: GDRFA specifies continuous or intermittent stay up to 90 days in any one year measured from first entry; may extend for similar period subject to total 180 days/year.
ICP specifies no more than 90 days within a single year and extension up to 180 days total; unused days do not carry over.

GDRFA states five years from issue; first-entry window described as two months, extendable two additional months. ICP describes first-entry validity as 60 days; confirm applicable Dubai rule before use.

Official GDRFA and federal sources describe the five-year multiple-entry product as available to foreign nationals/all nationalities. The ICP page in this source set is explicitly a family-group service; confirm the appropriate individual-applicant route for an Indian ordinary-passport holder before use.

sources.title: Issuance of a single-entry tourist visa
sources.organization: General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs – Dubai (GDRFA Dubai)
sources.evidence_excerpt: The foreigner is granted an entry visa for a single visit for tourism for a period of 30 or 60 days, sponsor/host should be an establishment working in tourism. Requirements: one personal photo, passport copy. Passport validity not less than six months; ticket to continue journey or leave UAE; medical insurance valid in UAE. Fees: AED 200 (30-day), AED 300 (60-day), plus 5% VAT; expected completion 48 hours. Only accredited tourism offices in the emirate can issue this kind of visa.
reliability_notes: Official Dubai immigration service page; fee total may vary according to circumstances.

sources.title: Issuing a multi-entry tourist visa (5 years)
sources.organization: General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs – Dubai (GDRFA Dubai)
sources.evidence_excerpt: Tourism visa for several trips, valid for five years from issue, without guarantor/host. Requirements: photo, passport copy valid at least six months, six months bank statement, health insurance, round-trip ticket. Bank balance $4,000 or equivalent over six months. Continuous or intermittent stay not exceeding 90 days in any one year, extendable for similar period if total does not exceed 180 days/year. Fees list totals AED 3,713; expected completion 48 hours. Entry valid within two months of issue, extendable two additional months.
reliability_notes: Official GDRFA Dubai page; its entry-validity language differs in detail from ICP page, so review before operational use.

sources.title: Issuance of a long-term multiple-entry tourist visa for a family group – 5 years
sources.organization: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP)
sources.evidence_excerpt: Five-year multiple-entry tourist visa without sponsor, available to all nationalities. Bank statement stamped, signed, in color, issued by bank, showing minimum balance of USD 4,000 per month or equivalent over past six months. UAE-issued health insurance valid 180 days. Entry visa valid 60 days from issuance for first entry; stay cap 90 days within a year from first entry, extendable same length subject to 180 days total/year. Required list includes passport, photo, insurance, bank statement, return/connecting ticket. Application AED 100, issuance AED 500, guarantee AED 3,000, guarantee deposit AED 20, smart services AED 100; completion 2 days.
reliability_notes: Official federal service card; title says family group, so single-applicant scope should be confirmed. Page last updated December 11, 2024 despite site footer 2026.

sources.title: Tourist visa
supports: five-year all-nationality eligibility, stay, financial and insurance requirements
sources.evidence_excerpt: Tourist visas can be applied for through airlines, hotels and travel agents. Five-year multiple-entry visa is self-sponsored, issued for all nationalities, permits 90 days per visit and can be extended for further 90 days. Requirements include USD 4,000 bank balance over last six months, UAE-valid health insurance valid 180 days, and continuing/return ticket. UAE-based airline, tour agency or hotel applies on applicant’s behalf; licensed agent/hotel route may require ticket purchase and hotel reservation with it.
reliability_notes: Official UAE government portal; general overview, not full category-specific Dubai checklist.
